# Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH)

> > The global authority on tall buildings and sustainable urban design, providing research, standards, and technical resources for the architecture, engineering, and construction industries.

CTBUH is the world's leading resource for professionals involved in the planning, design, construction, and operation of tall buildings and future cities. The organization develops industry standards, maintains comprehensive databases, and promotes best practices in sustainable vertical urbanism through research, publications, and technical guidance including Building Information Modeling (BIM), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), and environmental assessment frameworks like BREEAM.

## Key Topics

- Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH)
- Tall Buildings & Skyscrapers
- Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
- Sustainable Urban Design
- BREEAM Certification
- Artificial Intelligence in Construction
- Vertical Urbanism
- Architecture Standards
- Construction Terminology
- Structural Engineering
- Green Building Technologies
- Urban Habitat Development
